text:
Maria: Quick planning thread — want to finalize partner selection rubric + ops constraints before outreach. Goal: pick 6 partners for private alpha (4 sandbox, 2 integration). Need a defensible scoring approach so sales/CS decisions are transparent.

Aj: Good call. We should score partners on 5 axes: product fit, feedback cadence reliability, integration effort, infra sensitivity (data regs), and potential for measurable metrics. Keep it lightweight.

Sophie: Proposed weights: product_fit 30%, feedback_quality 25%, integration_effort -20% (lower is better), compliance_risk 15%, metric_signal 10%. We can normalize scores to 100. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Tariq: CS capacity: we can run 6 concurrent partners but only 2 active deep integrations at once (max 3 over whole alpha). Also prefer partners with existing infra on hosted flows to reduce ops.

Ravi: Legal note — any integration track partner will need a simple NDA + data processing addendum. We can pre-seed a two-page agreement. That will add ~3 business days to onboarding. Flagging for timeline.

Maria: OK — timeline impact noted. Suggest we treat NDA delay as a negative modifier in the score for integration-track candidates.

Aj: For telemetry, minimal events: session_start, prompt, response_time_ms, error_code, user_feedback (good/bad), and eval_marker. We'll provide a tiny SDK snippet partners can drop in. Example (copyable):
```json
{"event":"response_time_ms","value":234,"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"rw-v1-small"}
```

Sophie: Outreach copy idea (short):
"Hi <name>, we'd love your help shaping Redwood's private alpha. Commitment: 4 weeks, weekly 30-min sync, short async feedback. Reply with preferred track: sandbox or integration. We'll share a short checklist & sample prompts after acceptance."

Maria: Back to rubric — Aj can you draft a one-line scoring guide for each axis so reviewers are consistent? e.g., product_fit = 5 if core use is LLM-heavy and maps to our routing goals; integration_effort = 1 if no infra change.

Aj: Yep. Draft scoring guide: product_fit (1-5), feedback_quality (1-5), integration_effort (1-5 where 1=low effort), compliance_risk (1-5 where 5=high risk), metric_signal (1-5). We'll invert integration_effort later so higher overall is better.

Tariq: Can we add a quick deprioritization rule: if compliance_risk >=4 and requires on-prem, move to private track and exclude from alpha. Saves us false positives.

Ravi: Agreed. Also require legal ack before calendar invite for integration track. I'll prepare the two-pager and share in the doc.

Sophie: For partner incentives — propose early credits + 1:1 product design session for integrations. Keep it simple, avoid heavy financial incentives for alpha.

Maria: Good. Let's also set entry acceptance SLA: partners must confirm within 5 business days of invite or we reallocate the slot.

Aj: Ops note: we'll need to reserve a short eng spike window for onboarding integrations. Recommend blocking 1 dev-day per integration during the alpha window.

Tariq: I'll schedule onboarding slots (2-hour windows) and keep a waitlist. CS will do the 30m weekly check-ins and collect Looms.

Maria: Action items:
- Aj: write scoring guide + minimal event SDK by Fri EOD
- Sophie: finalize invite copy, QA checklist, incentive language by Thu
- Ravi: draft NDA + DPA two-pager and share by Thu
- Tariq: draft outreach calendar + slot cadence + waitlist by Fri
- Maria: assemble shortlist of 12 candidate partners and run scoring matrix next Mon

beta-bot: Calendar: "Private Alpha: Partner scoring review" Mon 09:00 PST (organizer: Maria).

Sophie: One more ask — include a small example prompt set (5 prompts) that covers edge failure modes. I'll author that and add to the acceptance packet.

Aj: Also adding a regression trigger: if any partner signals >15% increase in error rate or >30% latency spike on core route, flag for immediate triage. We'll include that in the checklist.

Maria: Perfect. If no objections, I'll run the shortlist and publish invites next week. If someone wants to swap weights on the rubric, call it out now.

Tariq: Fine with weights as proposed. Ready to run outreach when doc is live.

Ravi: Looks good from legal standpoint pending the two-pager review.

Maria: Closing — I'll update the central doc and tag owners. Thanks all.
